items.claim: Islam Dulatov has knockout power, good movement, and attacks the body and legs.
items.quote: He's a striker. He's got power, plenty of movement, does a really good job working the body and the legs.

items.claim: Islam Dulatov has solid takedown defense and offensive submissions.
items.quote: His takedown defense is pretty solid as well, and he has some offensive submissions if they end up on the ground.

items.claim: Islam Dulatov knocked out Adam Fugitt last year.
items.quote: He knocked out Adam Fugitt last year around this time

items.claim: Wellington Turman is coming off a three-year layoff.
items.quote: Then he took a three-year layoff and now here he is back after three years no fighting.

items.claim: Wellington Turman is coming off three consecutive losses.
items.quote: He's coming off three losses in a row to decent fighters.

items.claim: Wellington Turman is a good grappler who chases and finds submissions in scrambles.
items.quote: When he does fight he's a good grappler. He will find submissions. He'll chase them.
